readme: Shared expectations for the exercise label builder. The backend and the Next.js app compile under separate tsconfigs that exclude each other, so lib/exercise-display.ts and backend/src/domain/exercise-display.ts hold mirrored copies of the algorithm. Both test suites read this file, so a change to one copy fails the other suite. Add every new case here rather than in a single suite.

cases.name: equipment-style variation in front of the exercise name
parenthesized equipment moves ahead of the modifier
dash modifier on the exercise name
default variation keeps the exercise name and hoists its equipment
modifier repeated by exercise name and variation is written once
variation fully contained in the exercise name is dropped
only the overlapping word of the variation is dropped
equipment already in the exercise name is not repeated
equipment in the exercise name is not repeated for a default variation
a variation that shares no word is kept in full
isDefault flag wins over the variation name
variation alone when the exercise has no name
missing variation name falls back to the exercise name
